mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM chat_room WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT r.id, r.title, r.created_at, r.last_active_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_message m WHERE m.room_id = r.id) AS message_count FROM chat_room r ORDER BY r.last_active_at DESC, r.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_room SET title = #{title} WHERE id = #{id} AND title IS NULL
UPDATE chat_room SET last_active_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_message (room_id, role, content) VALUES (#{roomId}, #{role}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT role, content, created_at FROM chat_message WHERE room_id = #{roomId} ORDER BY id
SELECT retention_days FROM chat_settings WHERE id = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_settings SET retention_days = #{days} WHERE id = 1
